properties.label: Did {[Client.NameCO]} have any children or step-children with {[PriorSpouseName|else: "this spouse"]}?

formulas.name: ChildrenWithThisSpouse
formulas.expression: ["peek((isDecedent1TF && ChildrenTF) || (isDecedent2TF && MarriedTF && JointSuccessionTF && SpouseIsDecedentMC == \"Yes\" && ChildrenTF) || (isDecedent2TF && UseClient2TF && Children2TF)) && (this.TypesOfChildrenWithSpouse|contains: \"Children\") && peek(this.ChildrenWithPriorSpouse)\n       ? peek(this.ChildrenWithPriorSpouse)\n       : []"]

formulas.name: StepchildrenWithThisSpouse
formulas.expression: ["peek((isDecedent1TF && ChildrenTF) || (isDecedent2TF && MarriedTF && JointSuccessionTF && SpouseIsDecedentMC == \"Yes\" && ChildrenTF) || (isDecedent2TF && UseClient2TF && Children2TF)) && (this.TypesOfChildrenWithSpouse|contains: \"Stepchildren\") && peek(this.StepChildrenWithPriorSpouse)\n    ? peek(this.StepChildrenWithPriorSpouse)\n    : []"]

formulas.name: ChildrenWithThisSpouseAllSameTF
formulas.expression:
(isDecedent2TF && MarriedTF && JointSuccessionTF && SpouseIsDecedentMC == "Yes" && ChildrenTF) || (isDecedent2TF && UseClient2TF && Children2TF) 
   ? ChildrenWithThisSpouse.length > 1
   ? !(ChildrenWithThisSpouse|every: IsPredeceased2TF) && !(ChildrenWithThisSpouse|every: !IsPredeceased2TF)
   : true
   : ChildrenWithThisSpouse.length > 1
   ? !(ChildrenWithThisSpouse|every: IsPredeceasedTF) && !(ChildrenWithThisSpouse|every: !IsPredeceasedTF)
   : true

formulas.name: StepChildrenWithSpouseAllSameTF

formulas.name: ChildrenWithThisSpouseAllSameAdoptedTF
formulas.expression:
(isDecedent2TF && MarriedTF && JointSuccessionTF && SpouseIsDecedentMC == "Yes" && ChildrenTF) || (isDecedent2TF && UseClient2TF && Children2TF)
   ? (ChildrenWithThisSpouse|filter: ChildAdoptedTF).length > 1
      ? !((ChildrenWithThisSpouse|filter: ChildAdoptedTF)|every: IsPredeceased2TF) && !((ChildrenWithThisSpouse|filter: ChildAdoptedTF)|every: !IsPredeceased2TF)
      : true
   : (ChildrenWithThisSpouse|filter: ChildAdoptedTF).length > 1
      ? !((ChildrenWithThisSpouse|filter: ChildAdoptedTF)|every: IsPredeceasedTF) && !((ChildrenWithThisSpouse|filter: ChildAdoptedTF)|every: !IsPredeceasedTF)
